x: One of our recent recruits, John Collier, ran well in his first race for the Club and should soon become a more than useful runner. If the remainder of the winter fixtures are supported as well as this one, then Belgrave is indeed on the road back to their all-conquering past in cross-country running.

A further gap followed before Dennis Jones appeared 83rd, John Collier 90th and Mike Stearman 92nd. Don Maclean was having one of his days and was lying 120th and Alan Bishop completed our contingent in 125th place.

Brian Sawyer a greatly improving runner, more at home over longer distances, took the first handicap prize with Brian Johnston, John Collier and Charlie Henn sharing second place- how's that for handicapping?!!
